<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="8Iuok7xjaDMyoqL5PizS"> <mxGraphModel dx="1313" dy="707" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
autonumber
actor \"System Admin\" as Admin
participant \"SmartStream Web App\" as App
participant \"Backend API\" as System
database \"Auth Database\" as DB

Admin -> App: openUserManagement()
App -> System: requestUserList(Admin_Token)
System -> System: validateAdminToken(Admin_Token)
System -> DB: fetchAllUsers()
DB --> System: returnUsers()
System --> App: renderUserTable()
Admin -> App: changeUserRole(Target_UserID, \"Manager\")
App -> System: updateRole(Target_UserID, \"Manager\")
System -> DB: saveNewRole(Target_UserID, \"Manager\")
DB --> System: confirmSave()
System --> App: sendSuccessAlert()
App --> Admin: display \"Role Updated Successfully\"
@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="6oup_9ai100LGYIRGziL-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="454" width="937" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
